name: settings
title: Settings
author: Bennett Garcia
summary: Browse extensions and configure the workspace interface.
description: Provides the Settings page for extensions, interface options, themes, icons and keys. Turning it off also stops this page; use the vqro badge or command palette to enable it again. Built-in recovery remains available with every extension disabled.

works_with.without: The Theme page has no themes to choose
The Icons page has no icon sets to choose
The Keys page has no keymap profiles
Extensions that offer a Settings page (Sidebar) are configured from their own popups only
No View log action; the log path is shown instead
